tei:div.tei:p: oṃ āḥhūm̐: nub phyogs bde ba chen po'i zhing khams kyi: sna tshogs padma stong ldan gzhal yas su: mgon po tshe dpag med la gsol ba 'debs: 'chi med tshe dbang thob par byin gyis rlobs: chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams kyi: 'od gsal lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang du: tshe bdag rgyal ba rigs lnga la gsol ba 'debs: 'gyur med sku lnga thob par byin gyis rlobs: shar phyogs ri bo ta la'i gnas mchog gi: rang byung 'gyur ba med pa'i gzhal yas su: mgon po spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs: skye 'chi 'gyur med thob par byin gyis rlobs: rnga yab zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtse mo ru: pho brang padma 'od kyi gzhal yas su: rig 'dzin thod phreng rtsal la gsol ba 'debs: tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par byin gyis rlobs: bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag gi: sgrub gnas arya pa lo'i dkyil 'khor du: grub chen rje 'bangs grogs lnga la gsol ba 'debs: tshe sgrub mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs: rgyal khams phyogs med gnas mchog dam pa yi// snang ba rang sar grol ba'i pho brang du// chos rgyal ratna gling pa la gsol ba 'debs// thugs rgyud byin rlabs 'pho bar byin gyis rlobs// gdul bya bka' bab phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas// snang srid dbang du sdud pa'i pho brang du// rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa la gsol ba 'debs// brgyud pa'i byin rlabs 'jug par byin gyis rlobs// mthong thos dran pas mchog gi dngos grub thob// zab chos gsang sngags gsar rnying pho brang du// sras brgyud slob brgyud rnams la gsol ba 'debs// gsang sngags bstan pa rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// skad cig dran pas byang chub lam sna 'dren// spyi gtsug nyi zla padma'i gdan steng du// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// rang lus rtsa khams dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du// yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// thabs shes zung du 'brel bar byin gyis rlobs// bka' dang dam tshig gnyan po'i dkyil 'khor du// bka' srung mkha' 'gro chos skyong la gsol ba 'debs// rkyen ngan bar chad sel bar byin gyis rlobs// phyogs med snang ba dag pa'i gzhal yas su// mched grogs chos mdzad rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dag snang phyogs med 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// bka' drin can gyi bka' brgyud bla ma rnams// rab gus gdung ba chen pos gsol ba 'debs// skal ldan bdag la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// byang chub bsgrub la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// sngon las 'phral rkyen tshe la gnod pa yi// nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*// tshe dang sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin pa ru// thugs rje ldan pa rnams kyi byin gyis rlobs// bla ma sku khams bzang bar gsol ba 'debs// mchog tu sku tshe ring bar gsol ba 'debs// phrin las dar zhing rgyas par gsol ba 'debs// rtag tu 'bral ba med par byin gyis rlobs//

tshe khrid rdo rje phreng ba'i gsol 'debs 'di/ rje 'bangs grogs lnga yan shog ser las yin zhing*/ zung sdeb mjug bskyed ma 'di me pho stag gi lo la dang spro bsam gtan du ratna gling pas yi ger bkod pa'o// shu bham// //
